2026-03-04T15:31:31.2562783Z

2026-03-04T15:31:31.3153096Z ## Phase 6: History Pruning
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3153564Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3154381Z Prune old daily summary comments on the dashboard issue to keep the comment thread manageable.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3155514Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3155787Z ### 6.1 Enumerate Comments
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3156249Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3156572Z Fetch ALL comments on the dashboard issue:
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3157501Z ```
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3158401Z GET /repos/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/{number}/comments?per_page=100
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3159772Z ```
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3160320Z Paginate if needed.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3160706Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3160982Z ### 6.2 Filter to Bot Comments
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3161492Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3162520Z Only consider comments whose body starts with `## 📋 Health Check`. **Never** hide human-authored comments.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3163784Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3164049Z ### 6.3 Parse Dates
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3164422Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3165728Z Extract the date from each matching comment's title line: `## 📋 Health Check — {date}`. If the date cannot be parsed, skip that comment.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3167231Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3167530Z ### 6.4 Apply Retention Rules
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3168031Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3168293Z For each bot comment:
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3168981Z - **Age ≤ 10 days** → KEEP
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3170989Z - **10 days < age ≤ 1 year** → Group by ISO week (year + week number). Within each week, keep only the **latest** comment. Mark all others for hiding.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3172864Z - **Age > 1 year** → Mark for hiding.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3173415Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3173690Z ### 6.5 Hide Marked Comments
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3174155Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3174789Z For each comment marked for hiding, use `hide-comment` with reason `OUTDATED`.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3175741Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3175989Z **Constraints:**
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3177422Z - Maximum 60 hide operations per run (safe-output limit). If more than 60 need pruning, prioritize the **oldest** first.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3179171Z - Skip comments that are already minimized/hidden.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3180711Z - Log the count: "Pruned {N} comments: {X} older than 1 year, {Y} redundant within-week."
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3181742Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3181989Z ### 6.6 Edge Cases
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3182721Z - **First run:** No comments exist yet. Skip pruning.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3183910Z - **No comments to prune:** Skip and log "No comments need pruning."
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3184735Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3184960Z ---

2026-03-04T15:31:31.3185510Z ## Error Handling
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3185878Z 
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3187030Z - If any API call returns 404 or 403, skip that check and note in the output: "⚠️ Skipped: {check_name} (API error: {status})".
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3189741Z - If rate-limited, retry once after a brief pause. If still limited, skip remaining checks in that category and note in the output.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3192797Z - If no cache files exist (first run), skip delta/trend computations. Display "N/A" or "—" for previous values and deltas. Note "First run" in the daily comment.
2026-03-04T15:31:31.3195231Z - If the issue body exceeds 60,000 characters, apply the size guard from §4.2.
